info.name: PawShare API
info.description:
Every PawShare endpoint. Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner: each request saves the tokens and ids the next ones need.

Before running: start the server (`npm run dev`) and create an admin with `npm run create-admin -- admin@pawshare.com "change-me-123"`, then set `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` in the collection variables if you used different ones.

Protected requests send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign up, log in, current user. Admins can't sign up — use the create-admin script.

exec: if (json.user && json.user.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("adopterId", json.user && json.user.id);
if (json.user && json.user.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("shelterId", json.user && json.user.id);

request.description: Needs an admin created with `npm run create-admin`.

item.name: Shelter verification
item.description: Shelters must be verified by an admin before publishing listings.

request.description: decision: approve | reject. Rejecting an approved shelter revokes verification.

exec: if (json.animal && json.animal._id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("animalId", json.animal && json.animal._id);

request.description: Filters (all optional): species, breed, size, gender, ageGroup (baby|young|adult|senior), minAge/maxAge (months), city, temperament (comma list, all must match), listingType (adoption|foster), status (default available), q (text search). Paging: page, limit (max 50). sort: newest|oldest|youngest|eldest.
lng/lat of the user, radius in km (default 25). Nearest first. Accepts the same filters as search.
type: adoption | foster (foster may include fosterUntil). Animal moves to pending.
status: approved | rejected. Approving marks the animal adopted/fostered, rejects other pending applicants and schedules check-ins.
Only works while pending — returns 409 here because the application was just approved.

exec: if (json.thread && json.thread._id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("threadId", json.thread && json.thread._id);

request.description: Send { animalId } to message its shelter, or { recipientId } for a direct chat. Reuses an existing thread.
Oldest first. For older pages pass before=<_id of the oldest loaded message>.

item.name: Check-ins
item.description: Post-adoption check-ins (scheduled at 1 week, 1 month, 3 months) and health logs.

exec: if (json.checkIns && json.checkIns[0] && json.checkIns[0]._id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("checkInId", json.checkIns && json.checkIns[0] && json.checkIns[0]._id);

item.name: Reviews & profiles
item.description: Ratings, public profiles and adoption history.

exec: if (json.review && json.review._id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set("reviewId", json.review && json.review._id);
